exposure: Patients treated with dilatation and curettage
outcome: Success rate of different treatment modalities
Clinical outcomes of cesarean scar pregnancy
cohort: 64 women diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancy
finding: Surgical modalities with direct visualization, excluding dilatation and curettage, appear to be safer and more successful than medical treatment using methotrexate alone for the treatment of cesarean scar pregnancy.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at diagnosis was 6.5 ± 1.1 weeks
